logistic_regression.rationale: Linear baseline and the floor for the problem. With only two features it is also a serious contender: there is no high-order structure left for a tree to find. Smallest artefact, fastest inference, and the only candidate whose decision rule can be written down in one line.

random_forest.rationale: Bagged trees. Included to test whether a non-linear decision boundary in the watch-time / watch-ratio plane beats a linear one. Its cost is artefact size and inference latency, so it has to win on accuracy.

gradient_boosting.rationale: Sequential residual fitting. Included so that any boosting advantage can be attributed to the algorithm family rather than to one library. This is the candidate that previously shipped with F1 = 0.0.

lightgbm.rationale: The industry default for tabular data. Histogram binning and leaf-wise growth, with native early stopping. Expected winner on a wide feature set; on two features it has little room to differentiate itself.

selection.rule: 1) cost veto 2) paired-bootstrap tie test 3) cheapest of the tied

recommendation.rule: highest lift among operating points flagging at least 10% of traffic
